gitCommit.subject: Tests: a business zone whose hour every Node agrees on — Lagos, not Casablanca
gitCommit.body:
Tests: a business zone whose hour every Node agrees on — Lagos, not Casablanca

CI on tsx-public-site failed on every push from 4b61f79 to 8efa902. The trial
tests date the business in Africa/Casablanca and expect 09:30 UTC to read 10:30
there. CI's Node (22.23.3) carries newer time-zone data that puts Casablanca on
GMT in October 2026, so it reads 09:30; this container's Node (22.22.2, tzdata
2025c) reads 10:30. The product formatted correctly in both: it asks Intl for the
business's zone. Only the tests' hardcoded hour depended on Morocco's rules.

The fixtures now use Africa/Lagos: GMT+1, no daylight saving, settled rules. Every
hour the tests expect keeps its meaning (09:30 UTC is 10:30 there, neither the
server's UTC nor the runner's zone), and the zone's name is still read from the
runtime. A failed unit step skipped the preview build, which is why Playwright then
could not find dist/404.html.

Vitest: 18 files, 295 / 295, under TZ=UTC and TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
